plan: A small mage who gains power permanently over the game and can execute anyone.
aSurveiller: His E (Event Horizon). A cage that stuns if you cross its walls: stay in the middle or get out before it appears.
contrer: Never cross the walls of his cage (E): you would be stunned.
Poke him early to stop him stacking power.
Watch out for his R when you're low on health: it deals more damage to wounded targets.
forces: His cage controls a whole area.
faiblesses: His spells are easy to dodge.

sorts.P: Gains permanent power by hitting champions.
sorts.Q: Bolt that hits two enemies; he gains power if he kills.
sorts.W: Dark matter that falls after a delay.
sorts.E: Cage that stuns those who cross its walls.

momentFort: Weak early, stronger and stronger as the game goes on.
